decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates under the ACT umbrella sit close to the core offer and serve growing 3D-integration and high-frequency markets, and the firm is growing with slack to carry them, so results give no shortfall that would trigger search for other uses of the resources.

VLIS was only just launched with a dedicated page, matches the strategy of higher-value proprietary semiconductor applications such as through-glass vias for glass-core packaging, and an expanding, R&D-active firm has the slack to keep developing it while results are still uncertain.
